_comment: Campaign state of the evaluator coverage-closure loop. `pinnedGaps` are scenarios that are committed and red: the catalog data demands a behaviour the engine does not deliver yet, and each entry is one task for phase B. `parkedQuestions` are cells whose intended semantics could not be derived from the catalog data, the BSData wiki or the XSD, waiting for a human answer. Written by .claude/skills/evaluator-constraint-explorer; read by the campaign driver. docs/testing/worklist.json and docs/testing/covered-cells.json hold the coverage bookkeeping, not this file.

pinnedGaps.note: An atLeast(scope=force) condition whose childId names a root entryLink (9e50-7486-65ab-c449) must also count roster selections that carry only the link's resolved target id (8923-5946-7b10-8957, entryLinkId empty): with the toggle selected, the set-1 modifier must lift Greasus's max-0 constraint (cef8-c3b1-7850-85bc) so it no longer fires and the slot reports effectiveMax 1.

The Tomb stalker's unconditional Tomb-Scorpion infoLink (fe84bf5a-d0f1-4b5e-ae5d-475128f4ee32) must yield a profile info occurrence on the unit slot in EVERY force - in Standard (VC-AB) with the base values (Mv 7, name 'Tomb Scorpion', isHidden true), since no modifier of the infoLink is gated on that force; the report currently carries no info element with that id on the hidden unit's slot.

A modifier type="set-primary" field="category" secures membership in the named category on its own: 'Kathleen' Halftank (331a-3634-095a-574a) carries an unconditional set-primary on Regiment of Renown (ee09-9a50-ad78-9c32) with no categoryLink to it and no accompanying add/category, so in the force Standard (OK-AB) — which links that category — her Regiment-of-Renown anchor must report current 1 (the report has 0), and since set-primary moves only the primary flag and removes nothing, Rare must still count her, reaching current 2 with a second Rare unit and firing the .gst limit 0a44-2d3f-adfe-f3a1 (actual 2, bound 1).

A single selection of 'Tournament rules: Uprising (2026)' (4bc4-8781-2091-d9df, nested under the group 43b3-35c6-d7cc-e3c6 below the hidden entry 6fcf-b33d-3cf5-b56a) must be counted: its occupied slot must report current 1, and its own force-scoped limit 00f6-c1b3-ee85-5c02 (max 0, raised to 1 only while the and-group of atLeast 2000 / atMost 2500 on limit::ecfa-8486-4f6c-c249 holds) must fire with actual 1 against bound 0 at a costLimit of 1999 — the report carries current 0 and no message for that limit at all. Roster 03 additionally demands that limit:: reads the configured budget and not the spent sum.

An occupied slot must keep reporting how many selections it holds when its max limit has been lifted to the written sentinel -1 (unlimited). The Slaughtermaster slot (0ff3-ec4d-1c6b-6d53, frame Standard (OK-AB) 729f-9246-5cd3-5044) reports current 0 in rosters 02 and 03 where the roster holds 1 resp. 2 of them and the set--1 modifier on c70d-c292-36ee-21b5 has opened the cap; roster 01 is the control and passes with current 1 while the same limit still stands at max 0. So the count is lost exactly when the bound becomes unlimited, not in general. The limit's own firing/silence is already correct in all four rosters.

An option that exists in the catalogue but is not selected must appear in the report as an offer anchor, so its visibility is observable at all: 'Wolf Lord' (link b8be-a71f-569c-5cdc, target 66bc-8fc1-81a2-9cd4) carries hidden=true plus a single set hidden=false gated on atLeast 1 selection of anything in its parent frame, and rosters 01-03 assert exactly that flip (isHidden true at an empty frame, false once the frame holds one resp. two selections, current 0 throughout). The report carries no anchorKind=offerAnchor slot for that defId/targetDefId pair at all in those three rosters, so the flip cannot be seen; the same pair resolves as anchorKind=occupied in rosters 04 and 05, which pass, and the sibling scenario at-least-unit-upgrade-gate shows an unselected option's offerAnchor being projected in a shallower position. The option sits four selectionEntryGroup levels below the unit; whether the missing projection is the depth, the fact that nothing in that group chain is selected, or something else, is for the implementation round to diagnose. Without the anchor a user is never offered the option at all (ADR 0034: the report is the sole source of the surface).

Eine Bedingung auf das eingestellte Punktebudget (field=limit::ecfa-8486-4f6c-c249) muss dieses Budget auch dann lesen, wenn sie scope=force traegt: das .ros-Format kennt nur ein Budget an der Roster-Wurzel, also ist der Rahmen aufloesbar und liefert genau dieses Budget. Der Eintrag 'Border Patrol (500pts)' (2066-082d-a465-4baf, Mercenaries) haengt seine Pflicht (set 1 auf die min-Grenze 1a97-1579-ab05-a6d7) an equalTo 500; bei einem Budget von exakt 500 meldet der Bericht weiterhin effectiveMin 0 statt 1, und bei 499 wie 501 meldet er zusaetzlich die Diagnose UNRESOLVED_BUDGET_LIMIT. Unter der jetzigen Auswertung ist die Regel des Katalogautors tot.

A max constraint with scope="self" must make its own carrier selection the counting frame and count the selections underneath it: "Allow Mercenaries" (fda5-49b9-b74c-aaf4, game system) carries max 1 selections scope="self" shared="true" includeChildSelections="false" (714b-5314-33d4-dd68) and holds exactly two direct children (the two hidden house-rule entries 713c-28b1-0861-1ffd and 698e-c660-5c99-d481), so a roster holding both — and equally one holding a single child node with number=2 — must make that limit fire with actual 2 against bound 1. The report carries no violation for 714b-5314-33d4-dd68 at all in either roster, while the four silent rosters (one child, no child, and the frame-delimiting roster 05 where the PARENT holds two children but the carrier only one) all pass; so the limit never fires rather than counting in the wrong frame. The parent-scoped sibling 1df9-8159-156a-641f is asserted absent in every roster and is correct throughout.

An author message carried by a selectionEntryGroup must reach the report at that group anchor when its gate holds: the group "War Hydras of Naggaroth" (7f4e-4b7b-fbc4-a138, Dark Elves) carries a modifier type="add" field="warning" gated on an and-group of atLeast 1 selections scope="self" childId="any" (the group itself is the counting frame) and lessThan 1 selections scope="force" of the toggle "Allow experimental rules?" (e28d-f278-f209-63bd); a roster that chooses one member of that group without the toggle (roster 01) and one that chooses two (roster 05) must each carry exactly one authorMessage of severity warning at anchorDefId 7f4e-4b7b-fbc4-a138, but the report carries no author message at that anchor at all, while the three rosters demanding silence (empty group, populated frame with empty group, member plus toggle) are already correct — so the gate is not read too eagerly, the message is never projected at a group carrier.

A shared parent-scoped limit must report ONE violation for its counting frame, not one per counted selection: the Dark Elves unit "Reaper Bolt Thrower" (a757-462a-11d5-9636) holds three copies of the model entry "Reaper Bolt Thrower team" (8d99-db74-0051-4a45), whose max constraint ccf9-fefc-71c8-bd73 (max 2, field=selections, scope=parent, shared=true, includeChildSelections=true) counts 3 in that one frame and must therefore fire exactly once with actual 3 against bound 2; the report carries three violations of that same limit instead of one. The sibling minimum 41ec-bee5-0865-0448 of the same pair already reports exactly once in the four other rosters, including the frame-separating roster 05 with two units, so the duplication is on the max side of this pair, not a general one.

parkedQuestions.question: All six occurrences of this construct sit in the upstream corpus src/__fixtures__/whfb6/ (Vampire Counts.cat), which the black-box scenario author is not allowed to read — its allow-list covers only the frozen definitive corpus src/evaluator/__fixtures__/whfb6-definitive/. Should the allow-list be extended to the upstream corpus so cells that occur only there can be pinned, or should such cells be waived as out of scope for the E2E suite?
sourcesChecked: docs/testing/worklist.json (files map: 6 of 6 occurrences in src/__fixtures__/whfb6/Vampire Counts.cat)
parkedQuestions.answer: Extend the allow-list: the scenario author may read the upstream corpus src/__fixtures__/whfb6/ as well, so cells occurring only there can be pinned. Recorded in docs/agents/e2e-testcase-author.md; a scenario still names the files of one fixture set only and never mixes the two.

parkedQuestions.question: Der zweite append-Modifikator am Spruchprofil '1. Invocation of Nehek' (Vampire Counts) traegt das Attribut position="-1", das weder die Formatdoku noch das BSData-Wiki kennt und das die vendorte Catalogue.xsd nicht zulaesst (der Modifier-Typ deklariert nur type, field, value und join, ohne anyAttribute). Es kommt genau einmal im ganzen Fixture-Korpus vor, sodass sich seine Bedeutung nicht aus den Daten erschliessen laesst. Soll die Auswertung das Attribut als Einfuegeposition unterstuetzen (und die XSD wie bei multiply/prepend/join dokumentiert erweitert werden), oder gilt es als Datenfehler und wird ignoriert? Die Zelle selbst ist bereits gepinnt; offen ist allein das Merkmal Cast im greifenden Roster.
parkedQuestions.answer: Treat position="-1" as a data error: the evaluation ignores the attribute, so the append applies with its join separator and Cast becomes the base value, one space, then the appended fragment. The vendored Catalogue.xsd stays unchanged. The scenario may now assert the Cast characteristic on the holding roster; what it pins is that an attribute no source specifies is inert. Decision by the maintainer, 2026-08-11, transcribed from the session chat by the campaign driver.

parkedQuestions.question: The only repeat in the whole fixture corpus that counts childId="any" sits on the shared entry "Grappling Hooks" (6eac-4ed9-4511-ff14, game system), and that entry is orphaned: its id occurs exactly once in the corpus — at its own definition. Nothing links it, it carries no categoryLink so no force slot can offer it, and the game system declares no forceEntries at all; of the corpus's 141 repeat elements, no other one uses childId="any". So no catalogue-admissible roster can reach the construct, and whether childId="any" counts the query's own carrier among its parent frame's children cannot be triangulated from a second instance either. Should this cell be waived as permanently untestable on this corpus (recording that the entry is unreferenced upstream data), or should it be covered on the synthetic unit-test track under src/evaluator/ instead of the black-box docs/testing/ track?
sourcesChecked: src/evaluator/__fixtures__/whfb6-definitive/Warhammer Fantasy Battles (6th definitive edition).gst (the definition at the sharedSelectionEntries top level, and the absence of any forceEntries)
all five definitive fixture files (0 incoming references to 6eac-4ed9-4511-ff14; 0 of 141 repeat elements carry childId="any" besides this one)
docs/battlescribe-data-format.md 7.7 (childId values) and 5.6/8 (force slots resolve through categoryLinks)
parkedQuestions.answer: Cover the cell on the synthetic unit-test track under src/evaluator/, do not waive it. The maintainer's source https://6th.whfb.app/appendix-four-rules-of-siege/grappling-hooks shows the entry models a real rule - 1 point per grappling hook and rope, every model of a skirmishing infantry unit carries exactly one - which matches the entry's own comment "1p/model" and its increment of 1 pts repeated per counted selection, so the missing incoming link is an upstream data gap and not a meaningless construct. The counting rule for scope=parent with childId=any is already pinned from real data by the green scenario docs/testing/at-least-parent-any-reveal; the unit test carries that rule over to the repeat axis on a synthetic dataset. Decision by the maintainer, 2026-08-11, transcribed from the session chat by the campaign driver.

driver.reArmNote: Run 21, the first run after the maintainer restarted the campaign. Six explorer invocations spent the full cell cap and emptied the worklist: the coverage inventory now exits 0 with 130 of 130 cells covered. Four cells came out green (at-least-parent-model-champion-gate, not-equal-to-parent-lance-pistol-gate, not-equal-to-roster-limit-paladin-bsb, not-equal-to-roster-experimental-rat-riders), two red and pinned (at-least-self-any-experimental-hydra-warning: an author message carried by a selectionEntryGroup never reaches the report at that group anchor; parent-min-include-children-bolt-thrower: a shared parent-scoped maximum reports one violation per counted selection instead of one per frame). The campaign issue docs/issues/0149-evaluator-coverage-gaps was opened for phase B, but the maintainer interrupted the agile-loop workflow before it started, so NO phase-B round ran in this run and the issue file still lists only the first of the two gaps. The campaign is NOT closed - the termination check fails on the red suite and on two open pinned gaps - and no next run is scheduled: only a human starts it. Carried forward from run 20 and still true: the container starts without node_modules, so npm ci comes before the inventory. New this run: the E2E test catalogue docs/testkatalog-evaluator-e2e.md had drifted - thirteen committed scenarios were missing from its index table and its roster sum was 447 instead of 510 - which is now reconciled; that index has no generator and no CI gate, so it must be updated by hand with every scenario.
